summary: Text masking carded as the 4th rail tool, top of todo. User proved SAM3 text live in the node graph (bikini:2, individual_masks true, two clean per-object masks) after finding the Points tool over-selects on thin strappy subjects. Not a revival of the cancelled hover-enumerator Phase B. Four traps in brief.md; sharpest are the mandatory name:N count form and the MpiText-not-MpiString rule.
Checklist derived from plan.md (7 items: graph, executor, viewer, organism, registry, tests, doc).

All 7 items done. Three cheaper-than-planned deviations: no MpiText relay (CLIPTextEncode takes the dotted key directly), doc SPLIT to masking-sam3.md instead of trimmed (masking.md hit 232 lines), and onMasks now calls evaluateMask so a chip pick unlocks the op strip (also fixes Detect).

Text branch proven live on the bench engine: horn:2 = 2 chips, bare horn = 1 chip (the name:N trap, measured), horn:2+eye:2 = 4 chips, individual_masks off = 1 chip. New mask-text-prompt test 4/4; inject-titles text test negative-control proven. Full suite 239/248 with the failure list unchanged. UI never mounted - awaiting the user.
Needs a live app check: rail icon, chips, op-strip unlock, empty-prompt toast, tool-swap persistence, one remote run.

USER-VERIFIED live: bikini/2 masked both bikinis including the thin straps, cup, per-person hair, cup+earing gave 3 chips (multi-category stamping through the UI), empty prompt toasted without running. Remote Pod leg moved to the MPI-385 umbrella.
Text masking shipped and user-verified. Pod leg tracked on MPI-385.

Remote (Pod) run PASSED - MPI-385 item 2. Executed graph off /history: CLIPTextEncode text "dog:1" - prompt arrived as TEXT with the name:N framing intact, no media upload, points branch idle. Chips + mask returned. Characterized (not a defect): SAM3 scored the collar TAG as best dog:1 candidate on a frame-filling dog - whole-image subjects are its weak spot, inverse of the small/thin strength that motivated the tool. The last open item on this card is done.
